svg.title: Allowed positions change the normalized weights
svg.desc: Two four-by-four attention matrices use the same hand-set embeddings and projections. Each row sums to one. The causal mask sets future-key weights exactly to zero and renormalizes permitted weights. Positions are numbered one to four; displayed decimals are rounded.
